products.name: Cacao Citrine
products.shortDescription: A sophisticated modern composition marrying vibrant citrus freshness with the comforting depth of creamy hazelnut.

moods.title: THE COFFEE DATE
moods.visualDirection: An elegant coffee date, espresso, a chocolate dessert and an intimate café setting.
moods.description: For those little moments that deserve something memorable.
moods.storySnippet: When conversations stretch across warm cups and intimate table candlelight, you need a scent that feels both effortless and distinctive. Cacao Citrine brings crisp citrus brightness with creamy hazelnut warmth, while Roasted Zest adds dark cocoa nibs and smoked woods for café allure.

moods.title: SLOW MOMENTS
moods.visualDirection: A cosy coffee setting, a book, a warm drink and a relaxed afternoon.
moods.description: For unhurried moments and everyday comfort.
moods.storySnippet: For quiet mornings bathed in soft golden sun and the comfort of your favourite corner. Silken Sambac is formulated for personal tranquility, blending dewy white sambac petals with delicate cocoa butter and airy silk musks.

moods.title: AFTER HOURS
moods.visualDirection: An evening dinner setting, chocolate dessert, intimate conversations and sophisticated ambience.
moods.description: For evenings that deserve a little more character.
moods.storySnippet: As dusk descends and the atmosphere deepens, an evening calls for quiet confidence and magnetic warmth. Roasted Zest commands the room with smoky woods and bitter cocoa rind, beautifully complemented by the sparkling hazelnut glow of Cacao Citrine.

moods.title: A LITTLE INDULGENCE
moods.visualDirection: Hazelnut pastries, cocoa-inspired desserts, coffee and an elegant dessert-table experience.
moods.description: For people who enjoy the finer little moments.
moods.storySnippet: An exquisite sensory celebration of everyday luxury and dessert-table delight. Why settle for just one? A Little Indulgence brings together all three distinct expressions: the creamy citrus radiance of Cacao Citrine, the ethereal floral silk of Silken Sambac, and the smoked roasted depth of Roasted Zest.

moods.title: LIGHT UP
moods.visualDirection: A flick of flame illuminating glossy red lips, midnight allure, and spontaneous sparks.
moods.description: For electric nights sparked by bold confidence and magnetic warmth.
moods.storySnippet: A sudden spark in the velvet dark. A flick of a flame illuminating glossy lips, smoky allure, and unspoken chemistry. Cacao Citrine captures this intoxicating energy with radiant solar citrus freshness that melts into the rich, addictive warmth of hazelnut cream and roasted cacao.
